bofa.label: BofA Bull & Bear
bofa.description: BofA Bull & Bear at 9.7 (Sep 4); sell signal persists for 5th month since May; highest since 2021; Hartnett urges Retreat/Rotate from tech into staples/REITs/small-caps; extreme positioning across hedge funds, fund managers, equity flows

fearGreed.label: CNN Fear & Greed
fearGreed.description: Fear & Greed at 39 (Sep 10, CNN/cngold); down from 40 on Sep 9; still in fear zone; 1-week ago ~31 (deep fear); 1-month ago ~64 (greed); sentiment deteriorated from greed to fear in 4 weeks; stock price strength scores extreme fear

vix.label: VIX Index
vix.description: VIX at 16.46 (Sep 9, CBOE); up from 15.72 on Sep 8 and 14.3 on Sep 3; rising 3 consecutive days; below long-term avg of ~19.4; volatility creeping up but still compressed; neutral zone for VCP entries

aaii.label: AAII Bull-Bear Spread
aaii.description: AAII spread at +2.2% (Sep 3 survey, latest available); bulls at 39.7%, bears at 37.6%; spread below historical avg of 6.5% for 7th consecutive week; next survey expected Sep 11

cta.label: CTA Exposure Percentile
cta.description: CTA net exposure at 67th percentile (GS, Sep); up from 43rd percentile in Aug; gross exposure at 89th percentile; CTAs approaching full long positioning; Goldman warns of September seasonal risk; limited buying capacity remaining

cash.label: Fund Manager Cash
cash.description: BofA FMS: cash at 3.5% (Aug survey); below 4% sell threshold; 6th-lowest since 1998; net 56% overweight equities; Hartnett: uber-low cash = sell signal; Sep FMS not yet released

levEtfAum.label: Leveraged ETF AUM
levEtfAum.description: Leveraged ETF AUM remains elevated at ~$110B; no significant change; positioning risk persists

streetGamma.label: Street Gamma Position
streetGamma.description: SPX net dealer GEX flipped NEGATIVE to ~-$12.5B (Sep 9, Cannon Trading); was +$30B on Sep 8; gamma flip at 7,698, SPX closed at 7,636 (below flip); September monthly OPEX gamma cushion eroded; regime shifted from stabilizing to amplifying; dealers sell dips/buy rallies amplifying moves; call wall $7,700, put wall $7,600

sox.label: SOX Drawdown
sox.description: SOX at 11,931 (Sep 9, Eastmoney/Nasdaq); 3-month change -5.74%; improved from -9.08% on Sep 8 and -13.82% on Sep 4; semis recovering steadily; drawdown well below 10% bearish threshold; SOXX up 0.68% on Sep 9

ndx.label: NDX Performance
ndx.description: NDX at 29,441 (Sep 9, Nasdaq); down 0.23% from Sep 8; ~4.3% below 52-week high of 30,762; MAG7 mixed (Meta +6.55% on AI agent launch, others down); YTD +17.4%; bond yields pressuring valuations

russell2000.label: Russell 2000 YTD
